notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill covers Cloudflare Pages project setup and deploys with Wrangler, Git integration, preview deployments, Pages Functions with KV/D1/R2 bindings, wrangler.toml, _headers/_redirects, custom domains, and a GitHub Actions workflow.

Following it can make the agent install Wrangler globally (npm install -g wrangler), deploy to the user's Cloudflare account, delete a Pages project (SKILL.md:41-42, labelled as removing all deployments), and call the Cloudflare API with $CF_API_TOKEN to add a custom domain (SKILL.md:249-252). These are the user's own deployment operations, presented as reference commands, so medium risk is acceptable; project deletion and production deploys should be confirmed with the user.

Related-skill links (../cloudflare-workers/, ../cloudflare-r2/, ../cloudflare-zero-trust/, ../../networking/cdn-setup/ at SKILL.md:299-302) are optional pointers. IDs in wrangler.toml are placeholders.
